title: Empire Auto Boss ServerHop
features:
⚔️ Empire Auto Boss Hunter

Automatically detects active bosses in Muscle Legends, equips your existing Punch tool, locks you onto the boss, attacks at optimized speed, collects the reward chest, and continues hunting.

✨ Features

• 🤖 Automatic Boss Detection
• ⚔️ Automatic Boss Attacking
• 👊 Uses your existing Punch/Fist tool
• 📍 Boss Hitbox Lock
• 🧍 Upright Position Lock
• ⚡ Optimized 0.116s attack interval
• 💀 Boss Health & HP tracking
• 🎁 Automatic Chest Collection
• 📏 Automatic Size Adjustment during chest collection
• 🔄 Automatic Respawn / Punch re-equip support
• 🛡️ Staff / Moderator Detection
• 🚨 Staff detection notifications
• 🌐 Automatic Server Hopping
• ⏱️ Configurable wait time after kills
• 📊 Live Boss status in the UI
• 🔔 Staff detection history
• 📋 Staff history export
• 🎨 Modern Empire UI
• ⚙️ Fully configurable settings

💎 Built for Muscle Legends.

👑 Empire
